steps.note: Open the prepared project's RFQ Participants screen, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable surrogate bidding as required by the case.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the configured tenant.
Verify Vendor A is present and eligible for a surrogate bid.
Enter and submit the buyer-side surrogate bid for Vendor A.
Assert that the surrogate bid was accepted.
Verify the RFQ Responses view attributes the bid to Vendor A and marks it as a surrogate bid.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that the submitted bid is ranked in Master QCS.
